body.purpose: Descriptions, form copy, and table content.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates record, detail, and form panels from the cool page ground.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Adds a restrained physical edge to primary action buttons.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Communicates row hover, focus, and control state changes without decorative choreography.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The cobalt action used for record creation and form submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1f5b9b; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,38,56,.08); transition: background 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #194c82; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(77,131,187,.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action for cancel and navigation-adjacent choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: #172638; border: 1px solid #d7e0ea; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #e6effb; border-color: #b9cde2; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(77,131,187,.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact white field with a blue keyboard focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #172638; font: 600 13px/16px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input { height: 40px; border: 1px solid #c5d1de; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #172638; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5d6d80; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4d83bb; outline: 2px solid rgba(77,131,187,.2); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Record Panel
components.description: A bordered white surface that groups a record collection and its toolbar.
components.css: .ds-record-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d7e0ea; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,38,56,.04), 0 8px 24px rgba(23,38,56,.05); } .ds-record-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 20px; color: #172638; font: 700 15px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-record-toolbar span { border: 1px solid #c8d9eb; border-radius: 999px; background: #e6effb; color: #1f5b9b; padding: 4px 10px; font: 600 11px/16px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-record-rule { height: 1px; background: #d7e0ea; }

components.name: Application Bar
components.css: .ds-app-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 72px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e0ea; background: #fff; color: #172638; font: 600 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-app-bar span { color: #5d6d80; font-size: 12px; } .ds-app-bar:focus-within { outline: 2px solid rgba(77,131,187,.25); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: This system treats the application as a working records office rather than a health marketing site. The visual language is cool, precise, and quiet: a pale mineral ground supports white record surfaces, ink-blue hierarchy, one-pixel rules, and a single cobalt action color. It is intentionally light-first because the core users are scanning records, entering notes, and making decisions in a browser workspace.
keyCharacteristics: Record-first information architecture with a visible collection count.
Cool paper surfaces and precise blue-black hierarchy.
Compact sans typography with tabular IDs and dates.
Restrained elevation: borders and soft ambient shadows, never decorative gloss.
Responsive tables that preserve titles and actions on small screens.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Archive Blue is reserved for the action or state that helps a user complete the current task; it is not used as decoration.

rules.name: The Scan Rule
rules.body: IDs and dates use tabular numerals and a compact mono treatment so a record row can be scanned without decoding decorative typography.

dos: Do use Archive Blue only for primary actions, focus, links, and compact state emphasis.
Do keep the record count and collection title visible before the table body.
Do use tabular numerals and IBM Plex Mono for IDs and dates.
Do preserve one-pixel rules and soft ambient shadows around functional panels.
Do test the real table at 390px and keep the title/action path reachable.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, glows, or decorative blobs to create hierarchy.
Don't use a serif display face for product labels or record data.
Don't hide record IDs, titles, or actions behind hover-only controls.
Don't add clinical claims, production-security claims, or mock record content.
Don't replace standard form and dialog affordances with custom interaction patterns.
